exact_object: CNF satisfiability inside an input affine GF(2) space, represented by clause-falsifying affine subspaces after a charged parameterization x=p+B lambda
admission_condition: Every pair of nonempty forbidden subspaces is disjoint or nested
constructive_theorem: Laminar affine forbidden-subspace arrangements are decidable in polynomial total work by provenance-carrying basis construction, Gaussian-elimination recognition, maximal-subspace compression, exact disjoint union counting, conditional-counting SAT witness recovery, and disjoint-cover UNSAT certification.

basis_contract.construction: canonical Gaussian elimination over the input affine system
basis_contract.proof: RREF row provenance, contradiction provenance, particular solution, nullspace basis, free-coordinate independence, and reconstructed coordinate forms

independent_verifier.open_budget_rule: deterministic replay under the identical capability

literature_boundary: Arvind-Guruswami identify the unrestricted problem with CNF satisfiability in a subspace, Union-of-Subspace Avoidance, and common zeros of products of affine forms; C042 closes only the independently recognized laminar arrangement class.
claim_boundary: Laminar arrangements only. Crossing arrangements, arbitrary 3-CNF, unrestricted Horn-affine composition, and P versus NP remain open.
